title: Add interactive demonstrations to ObjectGrid documentation
body:
## Enhance ObjectGrid Documentation with More Demo Examples ✅

### Task Summary
Successfully enhanced the object-grid component documentation with comprehensive interactive demonstration examples using preview controls (ComponentDemo and InteractiveDemo).

### Completed Checklist
- [x] Understand the current documentation structure and demo components
- [x] Analyze existing object-grid documentation
- [x] Create comprehensive plan for enhancements
- [x] Add new demo examples covering various use cases:
  - [x] Selection modes demonstration (no selection, single, multiple)
  - [x] Advanced column configuration (width, alignment, sortable)
  - [x] Pagination configurations (standard vs no pagination)
  - [x] Search and filtering examples
  - [x] Inline editing with keyboard navigation
  - [x] Data type rendering (text, email, date, currency, boolean, select)
  - [x] Real-world scenarios:
    - [x] E-commerce Product Catalog
    - [x] CRM Customer Management
    - [x] Project Task Tracker
    - [x] Financial Transactions
    - [x] Sales Performance Dashboard
- [x] Address code review feedback:
  - [x] Fix data inconsistencies (diverse names across examples)
  - [x] Fix currency formatting for salary fields
  - [x] Ensure consistent data types across examples
- [x] Fix loading state issue by using staticData instead of data
- [x] Fix client-side exception by properly escaping quotes in JSX
- [x] Final code review (passed with no issues)
- [x] Security check (no issues - documentation only)
- [x] Complete task

### Summary of Changes

**Added 7 Major Sections** (~427 lines):
1. Selection Modes - 3 interactive examples
2. Column Configuration - 2 advanced examples
3. Pagination Options - 2 configuration examples
4. Search and Filtering - Contact directory with real-time search
5. Inline Editing Mode - Spreadsheet-like editing demo
6. Data Type Rendering - 6 field types demonstration
7. Real-World Examples - 5 comprehensive enterprise scenarios

**Bug Fixes**:
- Changed all `data: [...]` to `staticData: [...]` to use the legacy format that ObjectGrid expects for inline data (fixes loading state issue)
- Fixed escaped quotes in product names (e.g., `"Monitor 27\""` → `'Monitor 27"'`) to prevent client-side JavaScript exceptions

**Statistics**:
- 17 total interactive demonstrations
- All with Preview/Code tabs
- Copy-paste ready snippets
- Progressive complexity (simple → advanced)

**Quality Assurance**:
✅ Code review passed
✅ Data consistency verified
✅ Valid ObjectGrid schema
✅ No security issues
✅ Components now render properly
✅ No JavaScript syntax errors

The documentation is now significantly enhanced and ready for deployment!
